vocabulary.meaning: the legal ending of a marriage
examples: Divorce is an important idea when discussing divorce: Why does it happen?.
Learning about divorce can help us understand this issue more clearly.

vocabulary.meaning: a situation in which a couple stops living together or ends their relationship
examples: People often have different views about separation when discussing divorce: Why does it happen?.
Understanding separation can make a conversation about this topic more precise.

vocabulary.meaning: a lack of ability to live or work well together because of important differences
examples: The topic of divorce: Why does it happen? raises useful questions about incompatibility.
We can discuss how incompatibility affects people, communities, or the environment.

vocabulary.meaning: the legal responsibility for caring for a child after parents separate
examples: Custody can play an important role in debates about divorce: Why does it happen?.
Different countries may deal with custody in different ways.

vocabulary.meaning: a process in which a neutral person helps people resolve a disagreement
examples: A discussion about divorce: Why does it happen? can include the effects of mediation.
Knowing the meaning of mediation makes it easier to express an opinion on this issue.

vocabulary.meaning: serious or repeated disagreement between married partners
examples: Marital conflict is useful vocabulary for talking about divorce: Why does it happen?.
We can use the idea of marital conflict to compare different experiences and viewpoints.
